title: CAL FIRE, State Responsibility Area Fire Hazard Severity Zones (FHSZSRA_23_3), GIS data archive
notes: Exact HTTP response body served by CAL FIRE's CDN endpoint (HTTP/2 200, content-type application/x-zip-compressed, content-length 36001656, last-modified Mon, 24 Feb 2025 18:01:18 GMT, etag b913eaa131b7421fa81992d77e702392, content-disposition attachment; filename=FHSZSRA_23_3.zip); retrieved_at is the owner's recorded retrieval time (server Date 04:53:33 GMT). The link, SRA FHSZ Data Effective April 1, 2024, was found by browser-only link discovery on the official CAL FIRE / OSFM Fire Hazard Severity Zones page; the owner downloaded it with curl and uploaded it in two byte-for-byte parts, which reassembled to the owner's SHA-256 and size before any analysis. The capture environment could not reach the host (egress 403). Stored byte for byte as original.zip, never extracted to disk or re-zipped. The overlay layer is the FHSZSRA_23_3 shapefile (18,423 SRA polygons, EPSG:3310); the geodatabase copy is pinned by hash only. Classes come from the FHSZ_Descr labels, never the numeric FHSZ code, whose order is the reverse of the map legend's. No polygon means the land is not SRA, never a negative zone result. The archive prints no date of its own (document_date null); its metadata states the adoption and effective dates, and the fields listed as non_authoritative are kept but never relied on. idPurp repeats the OAL notice's slip Section 1280.1 for 1280.01.
